pages.title: Dawn at Hollowbone Manor
pages.scene: The ball fades as the first light reaches the garden.
pages.composition: Viewed from the manor steps, skeleton guests in rumpled elegant costumes drift towards open gates at dawn. The ballroom windows glow with candle shapes, while pumpkins, bare trees, ravens and a carriage wait beyond the path. The empty throne is faintly visible through one tall window.
pages.subject: View from Gothic manor steps at dawn, elegant skeleton masqueraders in gently rumpled finery departing through open gates; glowing ballroom windows with candle shapes, pumpkins, bare trees, ravens, waiting horse-drawn carriage and a faint empty throne visible through one tall window.

pages.title: The Manor Sleeps
pages.scene: A final exterior closes the story, with its secret safely inside.
pages.composition: A full portrait exterior of Hollowbone Manor sits beneath a crescent moon, with its gate closed and autumn vines climbing the façade. One upper window contains the small silhouette of the jewelled skull mask; the foreground features a stone urn of chrysanthemums, curled leaves and a sleeping skeletal cat.
